Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class ChatService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.ChatService
public class ChatService extends Object
UC6 Chat About Listing, shared by the Buyer and the Seller (Tasks 1.5 and 2.5): the private chat between one buyer and the seller of one listing.

How a screen uses it: 


 Conversation chat = chatService.openForListing(listing.getId());   // buyer, from the listing detail
 Conversation chat = chatService.openForOffer(offer.getId());       // buyer from My Deals, seller from an offer
 chat = chatService.send(chat, "Is it still available?");           // returns the updated chat
 List<ChatEntry> matches = chatService.search(chat, "available");   // A2

Rules enforced here, for every call, whatever the screen does:

  • Only the chat's buyer and the listing's seller can read, write or search it (Special Requirement 1). The admin cannot.
  • Only the buyer starts a chat, with the first message or offer, and only on a live listing, one that Browse shows. An existing chat stays open to both of them whatever happens to the listing later, so its history is retained.
  • An empty message is refused (A1). The other party is notified of every message (step 6; Special Requirement 4 for sellers).
  • There is no way to edit or delete a message (Special Requirement 2). A chat is deleted only together with a participant's account, by the admin (DataStore.deleteAccount).

  • Method Details

    • openForListing

      public Conversation openForListing(String listingId)
      The logged-in buyer's chat about a listing, opened from the listing detail screen. If the buyer has not started one yet, the chat is empty, and nothing is stored until the first message.
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the listing does not exist, or the buyer has no chat about it and it is not on the marketplace

    • openForOffer

      public Conversation openForOffer(String offerId)
      The chat an offer, borrow request or claim belongs to: opened by the buyer from My Deals (UC7 A4), or by the seller from the incoming offer (Manage Offers & Requests 3.6).
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the offer does not exist
      AccessDeniedException - if the logged-in user is neither the offer's buyer nor the listing's seller

    • getMyConversations

      public List<Conversation> getMyConversations()
      Every chat of the logged-in buyer or seller, the one with the newest message or offer first. A seller sees the chats buyers started on the seller's listings.

    • reload

      public Conversation reload(Conversation conversation)
      The same chat with its current history, for example after the other party wrote.

    • send

      public Conversation send(Conversation conversation, String text)
      Sends a message in the chat as the logged-in participant: stores it with the sender and the current time, creating the chat thread first if this is the buyer's first message on the listing, and notifies the other party.
      Parameters:
      text - the message; spaces and line breaks around it are dropped
      Returns:
      the chat with the new message
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the message is empty (A1); nothing is stored then

    • search

      public List<ChatEntry> search(Conversation conversation, String keyword)
      The messages in the chat that contain the keyword, oldest first, each with its sender, time and position in the history. Upper and lower case are treated as the same. Offers are not searched: they have no text.
      Returns:
      the matching messages; empty if no message contains the keyword
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if no keyword is given
